scientific_integrity: All-size proof supplied; two distinct finite verifiers support but do not replace it; independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-size formulas concern only the two boundary-column minimum separators in the three-row augmented grid; they are not all-pairs or arbitrary-height formulas. Earlier unit-step lattice-walk counts are prior art and are not asserted to be novel. An unindexed equivalent jump-route count remains possible.
title: Sharp token-jump relocation distance and route multiplicities for three-row grid separators
